Meta.title: Bruit
Meta.description: Report noise nuisance and spot noisy areas around you.

Measure.title: Sound Level
Measure.subtitle: Hold the phone toward the sound

Report.title: Report a noise
Report.subtitle: What are you hearing?
Report.measureIntro: Use your phone’s microphone to estimate the sound level. Point it toward the noise, then tap Record.
Report.measureHint: Point your phone toward the noise
Report.measureIdle: Tap Record, then keep your phone still while it listens.
Report.measureDenied: Microphone access isn’t available. You can still choose how loud it feels.
Report.measureUnsupported: This browser can’t measure sound. Choose how loud it feels below.
Report.measureError: We couldn’t start the microphone. Try again, or choose a level below.
Report.measureFootnote: Estimated from your phone’s microphone · {seconds}-second sample. This isn’t a calibrated sound-level meter.

Feed.title: Activity
Feed.subtitle: Near you, then by region
Feed.emptyBody: Noise reports will appear here — nearby first, then by region.
Feed.emptyScopedBody: Try another day, or report noise near you.
Feed.showOnMap: Show this area on the map
Feed.myReportsEmpty: Reports from this device will appear here.
Feed.myReportsEmptyScoped: No reports from this device in this period.
Feed.locationOff: Turn on location to see what’s nearby.
Feed.deleteConfirm: Delete this report? It will be removed from the map and activity feed.

Insights.subtitle: Select an area to explore its activity
Insights.emptyBody: An area appears here when it receives several nearby reports.
Insights.footer: Select an area to see when noise occurs, what causes it, and how intense it is. Each area covers about 120 m.
Insights.tapBar: Select a bar to view that half-hour
Insights.noReportsDay: No reports on this day yet.
Insights.loudShare: {percent} of reports that day described the noise as loud or very loud.

History.reportsHalfHour: {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}} in this time slot

Help.title: Help
Help.subtitleLocated: Contact a nearby police station or look up its number on Google.
Help.subtitleNoLocation: Turn on location to find police stations near you.
Help.locationOff: Location is turned off. Turn it on to find nearby police stations.
Help.noneNearby: No police stations found within about 40 km. Search Google for a local station.
Help.disclaimer: Bruit reports are shared by the community. They do not replace emergency services.
Help.searchGoogleAria: Search Google for {name} phone number, {distance} away

About.title: About Bruit
About.body: Find and report noise nuisance around you. You can send one report every 30 minutes.
About.appearanceFooter: Choose Light or Dark, or match your system setting.
About.bulletAnonymous: Your reports remain anonymous through your device ID
About.bulletLiveMap: Hot areas glow warm for about three hours, then fade to cool teal for up to a day
About.bulletLingering: New nearby reports keep an area active
About.bulletVerify: Nearby people can confirm a report or mark it quiet

Welcome.title: Report nearby noise
Welcome.subtitle: Share noise nuisance around you and see where it is happening.
Welcome.featureReportBody: Log nearby noise with Report. You can send one report every 30 minutes.
Welcome.featureAuthoritiesBody: Find nearby police stations in Help and call when you need support.
Welcome.featureAnonymousBody: Reports use a private device ID, never your name.

OpenInBrowser.messageChrome: Location isn’t available in this browser. Open this page in Chrome to report nearby noise.

OpenInBrowser.hintBrowser: Or use the menu to open this page in your browser.

Map.legendHotMeta: Less than 3 hours ago · warm colors
Map.legendDetails: Louder reports cover a wider area. Color shows how fresh a report is; the map fades activity over 24 hours.
Map.legendAria: Past 24 hours map legend. Warm colors are reports from less than 3 hours ago; cyan-blue are reports from 3 to 24 hours ago. {count} reports shown. Opens details. Levels: {levels}.
